name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-07-02, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.37 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
